Japanese BBQ with wagyu meat.
Feb 2025 • Couples
Near our hotel, in the central district of Saigon, setting and Japanese restaurant offering a sort of bbq at the table (in the middle of the table there is a gas brazier). Lunch fishing from the wagyu menu for lunch (meat in small portions, accompanied by rice, salad, vegetables, etc.). Fair level wagyu meat (not top but still pleasant). Good Japanese beer on tap. Services discreet, kind but with some problems with English. Spend about twenty euros each. A good solution for a lunch in a place with a typical and pleasant environment.
